bounded_obligation: Extend the already admitted rigid-torus advection obstruction to every fixed affine automorphism of the flat cubic torus with linear part in GL(3,Z), including non-isometric integer shears. This is a source-to-Lean construction-level nonidentity, not a claim about general diffeomorphisms or equivalence of Navier-Stokes equations under non-isometric changes of metric.

source_material.role: Autonomous W, October slow velocity U(s)=alpha_1(s)W, alpha_1(s)=(1+s)^-1 for s>=1, raw and projected forces
Lean advection operator and ZeroAdvection predicate
Previously admitted signed-permutation isometry case and off-center nonzero advection witness; do not re-admit

hypotheses: Use the previously source-justified row-2 d=+1 scaling pulse with N>=1, B=2K+2>=14, lambda=1/[100(m+N+1)]>0, epsilon=lambda/(4B)>0, and Q_r=(pi_r.x+epsilon,pi_r.y,z_r) in a cutoff-one neighborhood.
In the local chart W(X,Y,Z)=(c(Z)(X-pi_1),-c(Z)(Y-pi_2),1), with c(z_r)=-30 N log B and c'(z_r)=0.
Let A be any fixed integer 3x3 matrix with det A=+1 or -1. Thus A and A^-1 preserve the integer lattice and define a smooth affine automorphism x -> A x+b of T^3; b is a fixed torus translation.

Let a(t) be any scalar amplitude and tau(t) any source-time reparameterization. Assume at least one t0 satisfies a(t0)!=0 and tau(t0)>=1; no time differentiability is needed for this spatial advection identity.
Define V(t,x)=a(t) A U(tau(t),A^-1(x-b)), where U(s,y)=alpha_1(s)W(y). All equalities involving x are interpreted on the torus using periodic lifts.

theorem.affine_covariance: For every fixed t and x, (V(t)·∇)V(t,x)=a(t)^2 A [(U(tau(t))·∇)U(tau(t))](A^-1(x-b)).
theorem.source_witness: At Q_r, (W·∇)W(Q_r)=C e_1, C=225 lambda N^2 (log B)^2/B>0. For s>=1, (U(s)·∇)U(s)(Q_r)=C(1+s)^-2 e_1.
theorem.transformed_witness: At x_r=A Q_r+b mod Z^3, (V(t)·∇)V(t,x_r)=a(t)^2 C(1+tau(t))^-2 A e_1 whenever tau(t)>=1. Since A is invertible, A e_1 !=0.
theorem.consequence: No field of this affine-torus-pushforward ansatz can equal the pinned Lean torusSlowVelocity at a time t0 with nonzero a(t0) and tau(t0)>=1, because that Lean field has identically zero advection.

proof: For y=A^-1(x-b) and u(y)=U(tau(t),y), the spatial Jacobian is D_x V=a(t) A (D_y u) A^-1. This holds because A and b are independent of x and t is held fixed.
Multiplying by V=a(t) A u gives (D_x V)V=a(t)^2 A(D_y u)A^-1 A u=a(t)^2 A(D_y u)u. Orthogonality is NOT required.
At the admitted source witness, c'(z_r)=0, c(z_r)^2=900 N^2(log B)^2, X-pi_1=epsilon=lambda/(4B), and Y-pi_2=0, giving C=225 lambda N^2(log B)^2/B>0.
For s>=1, alpha_1(s)=1/(1+s), so spatial advection scales by alpha_1(s)^2. At x_r=A Q_r+b the transformed witness is nonzero because a(t0)^2>0, (1+tau(t0))^-2>0, C>0 and A e_1!=0.

The pinned Lean slowFromRest_zero_advection and initializedProgram_zero_advection feed SlowFluidProperties and torusSlowVelocity; hence its advection vanishes everywhere. Equality at the transformed witness is impossible.

replay.tool: CHAD WSL Python SymPy exact symbolic differentiation
replay.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sympy as s
X,Y,Z,p1,p2,a=s.symbols('X Y Z p1 p2 a',real=True)
q=s.Matrix([X,Y,Z]); c=s.Function('c'); W=s.Matrix([c(Z)*(X-p1),-c(Z)*(Y-p2),1]); adv=W.jacobian(q)*W
b=s.Matrix([s.Rational(1,7),s.Rational(1,5),s.Rational(1,3)])
As=[s.Matrix([[1,0,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,1]]),s.Matrix([[1,1,0],[0,1,1],[0,0,1]]),s.Matrix([[2,1,0],[1,1,0],[0,0,-1]])]
for A in As:
 assert abs(A.det())==1 and A.T*A!=s.eye(3)
 y=A.inv()*(q-b)
 V=a*A*W.subs({X:y[0],Y:y[1],Z:y[2]},simultaneous=True)
 predicted=a*a*A*adv.subs({X:y[0],Y:y[1],Z:y[2]},simultaneous=True)
 assert all(s.simplify(v)==0 for v in V.jacobian(q)*V-predicted)
 print('PASS non-orthogonal GL(3,Z) det',A.det(),'A e1=',list(A[:,0]))
print('PASS 3/3: affine covariance for non-isometric torus automorphisms')
PY
